_doc: HYP-05 closure record. Gate condition failed: HYP-03 SHIFT and WIDTH placebos match the real range on trigger rate.
gate_condition: HYP-03 SHIFT and WIDTH must not match the real range on trigger rate or gross expectancy
gate_result: FAILED — neither SHIFT nor WIDTH differs significantly from real (all Holm-adjusted p = 1.000)
width_result: Δ = 0.00pp for every one of 25 instrument-sessions. Same-width band at different location fires on identical days.
shift_result: Mixed — no pattern of real > shift. BTC/TOK -19.0pp and ETH/TOK -26.2pp show shifted window MORE active (wrong direction for gate). None significant after Holm.
rationale: Characterising instrument heterogeneity in a signal that does not exist (level not special) is not informative. The cross-sectional programme closes.
